terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.summary: These terms govern the use of Nexa as a B2B cold-chain ordering, validation and logistics coordination portal.
terms.noteHeadline: Cold-chain commerce, validation and dispatch coordination
terms.noteCopy: Nexa connects buyers, sales, logistics, documents and payment references so refrigerated orders can move with clear accountability.

access.title: Service access
access.description: Nexa provides role-based access for authorized companies, buyers, sales users, logistics users and administrators. Each user is responsible for keeping credentials private and using the portal only for business activities related to their assigned company.

requests.title: Buyer requests
requests.description: Products added through the catalog create purchase requests. A request is not a confirmed purchase order until the Sales team validates conditions, credit, product availability, delivery address and documentation requirements.

catalog.title: Prices and availability
catalog.description: Catalog prices, promotions, commercial availability and temperature requirements may change before validation. Nexa may adjust a request when supply, route capacity, cold-chain constraints or commercial agreements require it.

payments.title: Credit and payments
payments.description: Client credit lines, monthly limits, payment references and payment schedules are used to support commercial decisions. Nexa stores payment references as business metadata and applies credit status to validation and dispatch coordination.

orders.title: Orders and dispatch
orders.description: Confirmed purchase orders move through document preparation, operations readiness, route preparation, on-route tracking and delivery evidence. Timeline dates shown in the portal reflect operational events recorded for the order.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Invoices, guides, proof of delivery and related files are presented for business coordination. Official document validity depends on the issuing systems, tax rules, logistics evidence and the client document profile configured for each account.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.description: Users must not upload unlawful content, impersonate another company, attempt unauthorized access, manipulate stock or credit records, or use Nexa to interfere with the service, data or operations of other clients.

changes.title: Service changes
changes.description: Nexa may update workflows, catalog organization, credit controls, support channels and integrations to improve security, traceability and operational quality. Continued use after updates means the user accepts the revised terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This policy explains how Nexa handles business account, request, order, credit and logistics information inside the portal.
privacy.noteHeadline: Business data for refrigerated commerce operations
privacy.noteCopy: Nexa uses account and transaction data to validate requests, coordinate documents, manage credit and support delivery traceability.

collection.title: Information we collect
collection.description: Nexa may store business identity data, buyer contact information, company tax identifiers, delivery addresses, catalog selections, request comments, order items, dispatch events, documents, messages and payment reference metadata.

use.title: How data is used
use.description: Information is used to authenticate users, show the correct catalog and client profile, validate purchase requests, coordinate credit, prepare documents, schedule dispatches, resolve support cases and improve operational reporting.

payment.title: Payment references
payment.description: When a card or wallet reference is registered, Nexa stores only business metadata such as brand, last four digits, holder name, label and default preference. Full card numbers are not retained by the portal interface.

credit.title: Credit and collections
credit.description: Credit limits, used amounts, payment periods, due dates and credit status are shared with sales and logistics roles so teams can make consistent commercial and dispatch decisions.

access.title: Sharing and access
access.description: Access is limited by role. Buyers see their own company records, Sales sees validation data, logistics sees dispatch and risk indicators, and administration manages authorized users and configuration.

retention.title: Retention and security
retention.description: Nexa keeps business records for operational traceability, audit review and customer support. Reasonable technical and organizational controls are applied to protect credentials, account records and commercial information.

rights.title: User rights
rights.description: Authorized company representatives may request corrections to account, delivery, contact or billing metadata through the appropriate sales or support channel. Requests are reviewed according to company policy and applicable law.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Questions about privacy, account records or business data handling should be sent through the support page or the assigned sales representative for the client account.
